description: Full-text search over the meetings' transcripts, the summaries Georgia Commons wrote, and their titles and committees, grouped by meeting, each hit with up to three moments of the transcript and their timestamps. A bill number alone (HB 629) lists the meetings that took the bill up. Ask in the words a speaker would use. `in_headings` searches only titles and committee names.

body.description: Only this body, by its slug (house-rules, senate-judiciary).
body.title: Body

in_headings.description: Search only titles and headings instead of the full text.
in_headings.title: In Headings

kind.description: Kind of meeting: floor (a floor session), committee (a standing committee), or rules (the Rules Committee).
kind.title: Kind

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 40 (default 10).
limit.title: Limit

query.description: The words to search for, in the words the document itself would use.
query.title: Query

name: meetings_search
title: Search House and Senate meetings
